hero.lead: Hazy and Plummo pull up a stool and crack into the world of Australian woodworking — timber species, sawmill stories, tool talk, workshop craft, and the real conversations about men's and women's health that our industry needs.

videoTeaser.title: Video Podcast Coming Soon
videoTeaser.text: We're heading to the screen. Catch behind-the-scenes footage, workshop tours, and full visual episodes dropping soon.

hostsTeaser.text: Two Sydney-based woodworkers who've turned their passion — and their social communities — into one of Australia's best conversations about timber and the life that surrounds it. Together they represent Hazys Wood and Plummo's Timber, both well-known names in the Aussie woodworking scene.
hostsTeaser.studioText: Recorded at Oz Soundz Studios, Sydney NSW

sponsorCta.title: Partner With The Timber Bros
sponsorCta.text: Reach a passionate, loyal audience of Australian woodworkers, tradespeople, and timber enthusiasts. Whether you sell tools, timber, finishes, or safety gear — your product belongs in their ears.
